Sandbox_FYDS_Visibility_tooltip:
Who sees a death skull on the world map. Has no effect in singleplayer.
Only me: only the player who died.
Me + faction: the player who died and the members of their faction.
Everyone: every player on the server.
Sandbox_FYDS_AlwaysLeaveBody_tooltip:
Makes sure every player death leaves a corpse, which can still reanimate as usual.
Without it, turning on god mode while already dying shows the death screen but leaves no corpse and no zombie behind.
